views.name: monthly_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ctt.customer_id AS customer_id,
  DATE(ctt.txn_date) BETWEEN DATE('2020-01-01') AND DATE('2020-12-31') AS month,
  SUM(ctt.txn_amount) AS balance
FROM customer_transactions AS ctt
GROUP BY ctt.customer_id, DATE(ctt.txn_date)
views.description: Calculate the monthly balance for each customer.

views.name: customer_monthly_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    ctt.customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', ctt.txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(ctt.txn_amount) AS balance,
    SUM(ctt.txn_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ctt.customer_id) AS cumulative_balance
FROM customer_transactions ctt
GROUP BY ctt.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', ctt.txn_date)
views.description: Calculate the monthly balance for each customer, including cumulative balance.

views.name: customer_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ct.customer_id,
  SUM(ct.txn_amount) AS cumulative_balance
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY ct.customer_id
views.description: Calculate the cumulative balance for each customer.

views.name: monthly_net_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    ct1.customer_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', ct1.txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(ct1.txn_amount) AS net_balance
FROM customer_transactions AS ct1
GROUP BY ct1.customer_id,
STRFTIME('%Y-%m', ct1.txn_date)
views.description: Calculate the monthly net balance for each customer.

views.name: customer_monthly_balances_4
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    cdt.customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', mnb.month) AS month,
    SUM(cdt.txn_amount) AS closing_balance
FROM customer_transactions cdt
JOIN monthly_net_balances mnb ON cdt.customer_id = mnb.customer_id
GROUP BY cdt.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', mnb.month)
views.description: Calculate the cumulative closing balance for each month for each customer.

views.name: daily_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ct.customer_id,
  ct.txn_date AS date,
  SUM(ct.txn_amount) AS daily_balance
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
WHERE ct.txn_date = '0' -- Intrinsic filter: daily_balance = 0
GROUP BY ct.customer_id, ct.txn_date
views.description: Calculate daily balance for each customer.

views.name: monthly_balances_6
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.customer_id,
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', d.date) AS month,
  SUM(d.daily_balance) AS max_monthly_balance
FROM daily_balances d
GROUP BY d.customer_id, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', d.date)
views.description: Aggregate daily balances to monthly balances.

views.name: product_views
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  'product_views' AS view_name,
  COUNT(shopping_cart_page_hierarchy.product_id) AS view_count
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
WHERE
  page_id NOT IN (
    1,
    2,
    12,
    13
  )
views.description: Selects product view counts based on page ID.

views.name: product_cart_additions
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  'cart_addition_count' AS cart_addition_count,
  page_id AS product_id
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
WHERE page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
views.description: Selects product cart addition counts based on page ID.

views.name: product_abandoned_carts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  'abandoned_cart_count' AS abandoned_cart_count,
  page_id AS product_id
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
WHERE
  page_id NOT IN (
    1,
    2,
    12,
    13
  )
views.description: Selects product abandoned cart counts based on page ID.

views.name: monthly_interest_data
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    DATE(t1.month_year) AS date,
    t2.interest_name AS interest_name,
    t3.index_value AS index_composition
FROM
    interest_metrics t3
JOIN
    interest_map t2 ON t3.interest_id = t2.id
JOIN
    (SELECT month_year FROM interest_metrics GROUP BY month_year) t1 ON 1=1
WHERE
    t1.month_year BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2019-08-31'
views.description: Extracts monthly interest data with relevant columns.

views.name: rolling_average_composites
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    DATE('2020-08-31') AS date,
    i."interest_name" AS interest_name,
    AVG(im."index_value") AS rolling_average_max_composition
FROM
    "interest_map" i
JOIN
    "interest_metrics" im ON i."id" = im."interest_id"
WHERE
    im."_month" >= 7.0
GROUP BY
    i."interest_name"
ORDER BY
    i."interest_name"
views.description: Calculates the three-month rolling average of the maximum index composition.

views.name: interest_composition
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  i."interest_name",
  SUM(im."composition") AS "composition_value"
FROM "interest_map" AS i
JOIN "interest_metrics" AS im
  ON i."id" = im."interest_id"
GROUP BY
  i."interest_name"
views.description: Calculates the total composition value for each interest across all months.

views.name: btc_purchases_yearly
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS year,
    substr(member_id, 1, 1) AS region,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_btc_amount,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_btc_quantity
FROM
    bitcoin_transactions
WHERE
    txn_date >= '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY
    year,
    substr(member_id, 1, 1)
views.description: Calculate total Bitcoin purchase amount and quantity for each year and region.

views.name: btc_avg_price_yearly
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    btc_purchases_yearly.year AS year,
    btc_purchases_yearly.region AS region,
    AVG(btc_purchases_yearly.total_btc_amount) AS avg_btc_price
FROM
    btc_purchases_yearly
GROUP BY
    btc_purchases_yearly.year,
    btc_purchases_yearly.region
views.description: Calculate the average purchase price per Bitcoin for each region for each year.

views.name: calculate_average_loss_rate
views.description: Calculate the average loss rate across all items.

views.name: item_loss_rates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  v1."item_code" AS "item_id",
  AVG(v1."loss_rate_%" * 1.0) AS "loss_rate"
FROM "veg_loss_rate_df" AS v1
GROUP BY "item_code"
views.description: Calculate the loss rate for each item.

views.name: weekly_sales_2018_2020
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    DATE(cleaned_weekly_sales.week_date_formatted) AS date,
    cleaned_weekly_sales.sales AS sales_amount
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
WHERE cleaned_weekly_sales.calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
views.description: Selects weekly sales data for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020.

views.name: calculate_percentage_change
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    '2020' AS year,
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_date BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2020-07-17' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_date BETWEEN '2020-06-16' AND '2020-06-22' THEN sales ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN week_date BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2020-07-17' THEN sales ELSE 0 END)
    AS percentage_change
FROM weekly_sales
WHERE week_date BETWEEN '2020-06-16' AND '2020-07-17'
views.description: Calculates the percentage change in sales between the four weeks preceding and the four weeks following June 15.
